The `getCauseFromUnknown` function normalizes the `cause` by checking if it is an instance of `Error`. If not, it checks the type of the `cause`. If the `cause` is a primitive type, it wraps it in a new `Error` object. If the `cause` is an object, it creates a synthetic error by copying all properties from the `cause` object to a new `UnknownCauseError` instance.
